confirm_delete_customer: Remove this customer? Its server can no longer connect.
customer_env_hint: Add these two lines to the .env of the customer's server and restart it (docker compose up -d). It connects on its own; no port has to be opened at the customer.
customer_exists: A customer with this name exists.
customers_hint: Customer servers that report to this hub. To send them a message, create it under Messages and choose Customer as recipient; * reaches every customer.
delay_hint: Short blips that recover within this time never reach a screen.
deploy_msi_hint: One installer for every computer. Works with any software-deployment tool; updates and uninstalls cleanly.
deploy_script_hint: For a quick test on a single computer, with the plain executable.
deploy_token_hint: These commands contain the client token. It lets a computer read messages, nothing else.
download_package: Download the package for this server
drafts_hint: Reported by monitoring, not shown to anyone yet.
hub_error: Not connected to the service provider:
hub_ok: Connected to your service provider, last contact
install_cmd: Command for deployment tools: install or update, silently
integrations_hint: One webhook per monitoring system. Problems open a message, recoveries resolve it.
labels: Labels in front of the title
login_hint_directory: Use your directory account. Only members of the administrator group may sign in.
login_hint_standalone: Use the ADMIN_TOKEN from the server configuration.
name: Name
new_incident_hint: Appears on the targeted screens within a second.
no_msi: This server has no installer. Release images include it; for a self-built server, build Statusbar.msi (see docs/CLIENT.md) and place it at /data/Statusbar.msi.
not_delivered: not delivered to any customer yet
over_fullscreen: Stay visible above full-screen windows (remote desktop, presentations)
package_hint: A ZIP with the installer and install.cmd / uninstall.cmd, already filled in with this server and its client token.
pattern_hint: Wildcards: * and ?. Compared with "host/service", the alert key and its title.
rdp_hide: Hide the bar on that monitor – the client on the session host shows it inside the session
rdp_mode: When a Remote Desktop session fills a monitor
rdp_mode_hint: Applies to the classic Remote Desktop client. "Hide" (default) needs the client installed on your session hosts as well – without it, users in a full-screen session see no message; choose "Show the bar on top of it" then. Sessions across several monitors hide the bar on each of them. "Take out of full screen" only acts on single-monitor sessions and restores full screen after the all-clear.
rdp_overlay: Show the bar on top of it
rdp_windowed: Experimental: take the session out of full screen while a message is shown
rules_hint: Translate technical alerts into words your users understand. The first matching rule wins and is published without approval.
stage_draft: This is how it will look
stage_draft_note: Nobody sees it until you publish.
stage_live_note: Desks show this bar right now. Several messages take turns.
stage_quiet_note: No bar on any desk. Publish a message or let your monitoring do it.
subtitle: Subtitle
team_exists: A notification group with this name exists.
teams_hint: Combine computers, users, directory groups and OUs under one name, for example Finance team. Choose it as recipient under Messages. A connected service provider sees the names and can address them too.
title: Title
token_once: Copy this now – the token is shown only once.
